timeline.title: Install the zips
timeline.detail: Windows PC: Install Forever.cmd from the iCloud test folder, then Ravenpost's exe from Ravenpost/. Zips behind their tag? Refresh them first (amber on the cards).

timeline.title: Everything green on this page
timeline.detail: Cards green or knowingly amber, Forever build line unchanged, no card held. Anything red now is fixed before midnight, not after.

timeline.title: Launch: the login screen
timeline.detail: Bottom-left version line. 1.60.1 means our 16001 is right. Anything else: write it in Open questions, the patch wave carries the new number.

timeline.title: AddOn List at character select
timeline.detail: Click AddOns. Each of the nine must read loadable. Out of date or Incompatible is a red note for that addon (TOC / interface).

timeline.title: Errors on, a Skyborne in Zephras Isle
timeline.detail: /console scriptErrors 1, make a Skyborne, enter the world. A Lua error at login is a broken check on the addon named in it.

timeline.title: The per-addon pass
timeline.detail: 30 to 60 minutes, in the cards' order. Tick each check. Broken ones get a note and, if you can, a screenshot.

timeline.title: /codex scan on
timeline.detail: Leave it on while you play: the files feed Codex wave 2.

timeline.title: Morning: notes into the patch wave
timeline.detail: bun addon-kit/launch.ts notes prints the night. A session fixes each, one patch per affected addon, your go once for the wave.

timeline.title: Pins job (04:17 UTC)
timeline.detail: Does the launch build reach wow-data by itself? The Forever build line shows it.

timeline.title: Data chain check
timeline.detail: Launch build merged by itself, every addon's Game data green. If not, merge by hand (wow-data-prs skill).

questions.title: Interface of the release client
questions.ask: What does the login screen's version line say?
questions.ok: 1.60.1 (16001). Anything else needs the patch wave.

questions.title: _Camelot.toc still loaded
questions.ask: Do the nine show in the AddOn List?
questions.ok: All nine, so the suffix works at launch. The wiki says it may become _Forever later.

questions.title: The _forever_ folder
questions.ok: Installed into _forever_. If the folder moved, the installer, Ravenpost and the site's hint all name it.

questions.title: Battle.net gender on a Forever character
questions.ask: Upload a diary with Ravenpost: is the character's gender in the site's profile?
questions.ok: The site's French agreement reads gender from the Battle.net profile. Missing means a fallback is needed.

questions.title: Goodwill's Forever data
questions.ask: After 4 Nov, are Forever's factions in forever.db?
questions.ok: The faction count in Forever data below moves past today's. Second week at the earliest.

questions.title: A Forever Hardcore realm?
questions.ok: If yes, Second Wind gets Forever work. If no, it stays Era-first.

questions.title: Store pages under Forever
questions.ask: On CurseForge, does the Forever filter list our addons?
questions.ok: Filed under 1.60.1. Note the 'main file' label if it says Classic TBC first.
